description: Server-side add_account_properties posted to heapanalytics.com/api/add_account_properties. Heap requires app_id. Single updates send account_id; bulk updates send accounts[]. Track stays vendor/heap-track. Identify is vendor/heap-identify. Add user properties is vendor/heap-user-properties.

params.name: app_id
params.description: It is the Heap environment ID. Heap documents it as required.
params.fix_hint: Set `app_id` to the environment ID from Heap Projects.

params.name: account_id
params.description: It is the account identifier on a single-account update. Heap documents `account_id` for single updates, and `accounts[]` for bulk.
params.fix_hint: Send `account_id` for one account, or an `accounts` array for bulk updates.

params.name: accounts[].account_id
params.description: It is the account identifier on a bulk row. Heap documents each `accounts[]` object as having `account_id`.
